title: Strict limit realization of a complete compactification composite
statement:
Fix a prime $\ell$ and a finite extension $E/\mathbf Q_\ell$ with valuation ring $O$ [def-weil-l-adic-coefficient-extension]. On each small pro-etale site put $A_{n,T}=(O/\ell^n)_T$ and $R_T=\varprojlim_n A_{n,T}$, identified with the pulled-back integral coefficient sheaf [sk-def-sp-coefficient-towers, sk-prop-sfb-qlbar-colimit-x]. Write $r_TN=(N\otimes^L_{R_T}A_{n,T})_n$ for derived reduction [det-sp-reduction-tower-normalized], and $L_T=R\varprojlim_n\operatorname{Res}_n$ for total derived inverse limit of strict towers after restriction of scalars to $R_T$ [lem-weil-pbc-ringed-strict-tower-homotopy-limit]. All derived categories are ordinary unbounded module derived categories; tower operations are the simultaneous section-model operations of [lem-coef-semilinear-derived-sections], with exact evaluations [det-sp-coefficient-towers-abelian].

Let $X,\bar X,Y$ be quasi-compact quasi-separated schemes on which $\ell$ is invertible, and let $f=pj$ have a compactification with $j:X\hookrightarrow\bar X$ quasi-compact open and $p:\bar X\to Y$ proper [def-weil-compactifications-refinements]. Use $R\!f_!^c=Rp_{*,R}j_{!,R}$, the separately derived compact-support composite [sk-def-sfb-module-derived-lower-shriek]. If $M\in D(R_X)$ is derived $\ell$-complete, meaning its specified unit $\eta_M:M\to L_Xr_XM$ is invertible [sk-def-pe-derived-completion], and $r_XM\in D^+(\operatorname{Tow}(X,O))$, there is a canonical natural isomorphism
$$\alpha_{c,M}:Rp_{*,R}j_{!,R}M\xrightarrow{\sim}L_Y\bigl(Rp_{*,\bullet}j_{!,\bullet}r_XM\bigr).$$
Its normalization is the following equality of natural transformations: $\alpha_{c,M}$ is $Rp_{*,R}j_{!,R}(\eta_M)$ followed by the quasi-compact-open extension/total-limit comparison, the derived direct-image/total-limit comparison, and the coefficient-restriction comparisons. The latter identify $Rp_{*,R}\operatorname{Res}_{n,\bar X}$ with $\operatorname{Res}_{n,Y}Rp_{*,A_n}$ and $j_{!,R}\operatorname{Res}_{n,X}$ with $\operatorname{Res}_{n,\bar X}j_{!,A_n}$ as functors on strict derived coefficient systems. In particular its $n$-th projection is $Rp_{*,R}j_{!,R}$ of the actual quotient augmentation $M\to\operatorname{Res}_{n,X}(M/\ell^n)$ followed by these scalar comparisons. All quotient transitions are preserved. No constructibility, smoothness, normalization of an output tower, or uniqueness of cones in an ordinary triangulated category is assumed.

proof.text: Expand comparison at M: it is the image of the completion unit, direct image of the open mate, pushLimit, then total limit of scalarComposite. Completeness makes the first arrow invertible; the open comparison theorem makes the second invertible; the remaining factors are isomorphisms or their functorial images. Thus asIso of this exact morphism gives alpha and its required hom equality.

proof.text: Postcompose the expanded comparison by the actual target projection. Naturality of coefficientConstantTowerProjection moves scalarComposite through that projection. Apply the push-limit projection identity, then apply direct image to the open-limit projection identity. Functoriality and associativity combine the completion unit with the source projection into quotientAugmentation, leaving precisely finiteScalarComposite. This proves the augmentation identity for the already constructed map without inferring morphism equality from evaluations.
